title: On Instantons at Large Charge
summary: The large R-charge limit of two-point functions of chiral primary operators in rank-one $\mathcal{N}=2$ superconformal field theories exhibits a universal behavior controlled by the effective field theory on their Coulomb branch. In the case of $SU(2)$ SQCD with four flavors, this behavior is expected to be independent of the exactly-marginal gauge coupling. We provide an analytic proof of this prediction by computing the correlators directly via supersymmetric localization.
